about_the_game: Don't Forget The Bear is a relaxing and charming pixel-art puzzle game where you flip cards to find matching bear-themed images. With a 6x6 grid and 18 unique pairs to discover, this game challenges your memory and attention to detail. Perfect for casual players, kids, and puzzle lovers alike, Don't Forget The Bear offers a cozy atmosphere with a nature-inspired background, soothing gameplay, and adorable bear illustrations. Play against the clock or pause and enjoy at your own pace. Simple, fun, and surprisingly engaging!
